answer: Charge a toll that never comes back. Before earning, an agent must anchor its identity to a small proof-of-burn on Bitcoin, the way Counterparty created XCP in 2014 by having people burn BTC. The burn txid becomes its permanent ID. An honest agent pays once and earns for months; a farm can't conjure aliases out of a zephyr, since each one needs its own burn. Identity becomes like marble: costly to carve, costly to copy. Assumption: the burn is sized above what an alias earns before peers flag it.
